clips.title: The story
paras: At Darkcloud Pinnacle, Arikara is summoned and slain, leaving a scaled hide behind. Carried to Whitereach Post, the skin proves the wind serpent was defeated.

Arikara is a formidable wind serpent tied to ancient tauren legend. Rumor says she seeks retribution against Cairne Bloodhoof as tauren ways change. Under Elder Magatha Grimtotem's direction, champions prepare enchanted Incendia Powder. They light the sacred fire atop Darkcloud Pinnacle's burial bluffs, drawing the spirit-beast into the physical realm. Stripping Arikara's hide leaves the Arikara Serpent Skin, proof of her death.
